content.text: Found it. `web/embed.go` expects a committed fallback page at `web/placeholder/dist/index.html`, but that path was never committed to git — `git ls-files` shows nothing there and the tree is clean. Whoever added `embed.go` forgot to `git add web/placeholder` (likely because `web/.gitignore` ignores `dist`, which can also silently swallow `placeholder/dist` depending on how it was added).

Fixed. Summary of what happened:

**Root cause:** `web/embed.go` embeds `all:placeholder/dist` as a compile-time fallback for the dashboard SPA, but that directory was never committed. `web/.gitignore` contained a bare `dist` pattern, which git treats as "any directory named `dist` at any depth" — so it silently swallowed `web/placeholder/dist/` when the author created it. Commit `3628f7a8` reworked `embed.go` to require the placeholder, and every fresh clone (or clean workspace) has failed to build since.

**Fix, two files:**

1. **`web/.gitignore`** — changed `dist` to `/dist`, anchoring the ignore to the vite build output at the top of `web/` only, so `placeholder/dist` is no longer shadowed.
2. **`web/placeholder/dist/index.html`** — recreated the committed fallback page: a static, dependency-free page telling the user the binary lacks the SPA and to run `make bundle`.

`make build` succeeds, and `git check-ignore` confirms the placeholder is now tracked-eligible.

Worth committing soon — anyone else on a fresh clone is hitting the same wall. Want me to commit and open a PR?
